routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note by id (sets deletedAt so it leaves the main notes list and lands in Trash); returns 200 with the deleted note, 404 when the id does not exist
restore a soft-deleted note by id (clears deletedAt so it returns to the main notes list); returns 200 with the restored note, 404 when the id does not exist

notes: REQ-2.3.2: after a note is deleted from the home page, a delete notification (snackbar) appears showing the deleted note title and an "Undo" button; the notification auto-dismisses after 4 seconds or can be closed manually via a Dismiss (X) button. Clicking Undo calls the existing POST /api/notes/:id/restore route to bring the note back, then the page shows an "Action undone" notification (the snackbar text switches to 'Action undone'), and the restored note is visible again in the main notes list. No new backend routes are needed (restore already exists from the REQ-2.3.1 work) and the soft-delete flow is unchanged. The seed data in backend/data/db.json contains the deletable regular note titled "Delete me 2.3.2" (unpinned, not archived, not deleted, content 'Temporary note for deletion flow'), matching the fixture used by the REQ-2.3.2 acceptance test.
